releases.description:
### New: Open Backlink Search

Added a new **Open Backlink Search** command for quickly finding files that contain backlinks to specific notes or aliases.

The search supports combining multiple backlink references:

* Use `+File` to include a referenced file. Results show files that contain backlinks to this file.
* Use `-File` to exclude a backlink file and narrow down the `+` selection. The `+` selection only considers files that are referenced by backlinks, without including files excluded with `-`.

Multiple `+` selections are combined using an intersection, so the results only include files that contain backlinks to **all selected files**.

Additional features:

* Supports filenames and aliases.
* Provides a file picker with fuzzy search when adding references.
* Selected files are displayed as removable chips.
* Copy search results as Markdown links with `Ctrl/Cmd + C`.
* Open the selected file with `Enter`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rostunic/obsidian-alias-picker/compare/1.0.5...1.0.6

# Alias Picker v1.0.5 Release Notes

## New Settings
- **Split Sidebar for Alias Overview**: Controls whether the sidebar splits when opening the Alias Overview (default: true)
- **Open New Leaf for Alias Overview**: Controls whether a new leaf is created or an existing one is reused (default: true)

## Changes
- Settings are now managed via Obsidian's plugin settings tab
- Alias Overview view is reused if already open
- Sidebar split behavior is configurable

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rostunic/obsidian-alias-picker/compare/1.0.4...1.0.5

When renaming an alias, the plugin will automatically update all instances of that alias throughout your vault.
It also supplies a command "Open Alias Overview" to view all aliases in your vault and see the usages of each alias.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rostunic/obsidian-alias-picker/compare/1.0.2...1.0.3
